description: An 11-state vending-machine FSM with a wide combinational discount datapath: total_discount selects between two 1024-bit additions (discountA+discountB or discountC+discountD) with no register on the way from input to output. Single clock, active-high asynchronous reset. Violates timing at 5.0 ns on nangate45 by construction: baseline WNS -8.03 ns, TNS -4416.28 ns, 926 violating endpoints, 14,293 cells; worst path discountC[1] -> total_discount[1023], logic depth 542.

known_bottlenecks: total_discount computes BOTH 1024-bit sums (A+B and C+D) and then muxes on sel, so the critical input-to-output path is a full 1024-bit carry chain plus a mux
the path is purely combinational from input ports to output ports, so it gets only the period minus input and output delay
notes.invariants: rewrites must be bit-exact and keep total_discount combinational (0 cycles from inputs) and sell_signal a function of the current state; the state register and its reset value must be preserved
notes.fsm: states S7-S10 are unreachable from reset (S0); only S0-S6 are ever visited
